name: pp-max
effect: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases a selected move’s max PP to 1.6× its original max PP. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.
short_effect: Raises a move’s max PP by 60%.

flavor_text.black-white: It maximally raises the top PP of a selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.
flavor_text.black-2-white-2: It maximally raises the top PP of a selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.
